## Accessibility Issue

A clear description of the accessibility problem you encountered.

We treat accessibility issues as high priority. Thank you for taking the time to report this.

## Impact

How does this affect your use of ProveIt?

- [ ] **Blocking** — I cannot use the affected feature at all
- [ ] **Frustrating** — I can use it, but with significant difficulty
- [ ] **Minor** — Inconvenience, but workable

## Your Setup

This information helps us reproduce and fix the issue.

### Assistive Technology

What AT are you using? (Skip categories that don't apply.)

- **Screen reader**:
  - Name and version: <!-- e.g., NVDA 2024.1, JAWS 2024 -->
  - Browser/host (if applicable): <!-- e.g., Firefox 122, Chrome 121 -->
  - Speech synthesizer: <!-- e.g., eSpeak NG, Voice X -->

- **Screen magnifier**:
  - Name and version:
  - Magnification level used:

- **Alternative input**:
  - Type: <!-- e.g., switch access, voice control, eye tracking -->
  - Specific tool/version: <!-- e.g., Dragon NaturallySpeaking 16, Tobii Eye X -->

- **Other AT**:
  - <!-- braille displays, refreshable displays, etc. -->

### System

- **OS**: <!-- e.g., Windows 11, macOS 14, Ubuntu 24.04 -->
- **OS accessibility settings**: <!-- e.g., high contrast on, reduce motion on -->
- **Display**: <!-- if relevant: resolution, multiple monitors -->

### ProveIt

- **Version**: <!-- proveit --version or commit -->
- **Configuration**: <!-- relevant settings from ~/.config/proveit/ -->

What should have happened? How would this be accessible?

## Actual Behavior

## Specific Issue Type

What kind of accessibility issue is this?

### Screen Reader

- [ ] Element not announced
- [ ] Element announced incorrectly
- [ ] Reading order is wrong
- [ ] Live region update missed
- [ ] Math content not comprehensible
- [ ] Other: <!-- describe -->

### Keyboard

- [ ] Element not reachable via keyboard
- [ ] No visible focus indicator
- [ ] Keyboard trap (can't escape)
- [ ] Shortcut conflicts with AT
- [ ] Tab order is illogical
- [ ] Other: <!-- describe -->

### Visual

- [ ] Insufficient color contrast
- [ ] Information conveyed by color only
- [ ] Layout breaks at zoom level: <!-- specify -->
- [ ] Animation cannot be paused
- [ ] Flashing exceeds WCAG threshold
- [ ] Other: <!-- describe -->

### Audio

- [ ] No audio cues where expected
- [ ] Audio cues conflict with screen reader
- [ ] Audio cues unclear or indistinguishable
- [ ] Volume controls don't work
- [ ] Other: <!-- describe -->

### Cognitive

- [ ] Confusing terminology
- [ ] Surprising behavior
- [ ] Inadequate error messages
- [ ] Time pressure
- [ ] Other: <!-- describe -->

### Motor

- [ ] Requires precise pointing
- [ ] Requires multi-key combinations difficult to perform
- [ ] Time-sensitive interactions
- [ ] Other: <!-- describe -->

## WCAG Reference

If you know which WCAG criterion this violates:

- **Criterion**: <!-- e.g., 2.4.7 Focus Visible (Level AA) -->
- **Link**: <!-- e.g., https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG21/Understanding/focus-visible -->

If you don't know, that's fine — we'll figure it out.

## Screenshots/Recordings

If you can share visual evidence:

- **Screenshots**: please include alt text
- **Recordings**: please include transcripts or descriptions
- **Audio recordings**: of screen reader output, with transcripts

## Workaround

Have you found any workaround? Even partial workarounds help others.

## Suggested Fix

If you have ideas for how to fix this, please share them. We don't expect users to know the fix, but if you do, it speeds resolution.

## Additional Context

Anything else that helps us understand the issue:

- Has this worked correctly before?
- Does it work with different settings?
- Are there related issues?
- Has this been reported elsewhere (e.g., to your AT vendor)?

## Privacy Note

We may need to ask follow-up questions. If you'd prefer private communication for any reason, please indicate that.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this isn't a duplicate
- [ ] I have included my AT setup
- [ ] I have described the impact
- [ ] I have provided steps to reproduce

---

**Thank you for reporting this.** Your time and effort make ProveIt better for everyone. We'll respond as soon as possible.
